canvas_id.desc: Encoded ID of the canvas to fetch.

channel.desc: ID of the agent session channel the canvas belongs to.

content_format.desc: Format to render the canvas content in. Defaults to markdown.

include_resolved.desc: Whether to include resolved comment threads in the response. Defaults to false.

desc: Fetch a canvas attached to a code channel.

errors.canvas_content_fetch_failed: The canvas content could not be fetched or rendered.
errors.canvas_not_found: The specified `canvas_id` does not correspond to a canvas you can access.
errors.channel_not_found: The specified channel does not correspond to a valid channel.
errors.comments_fetch_failed: The canvas comment threads could not be fetched.
errors.not_agent_channel: The specified channel is not an agent session channel.
errors.not_authorized: The caller is not an authorized agent bot for this channel.
